ABOUT

Technology is useful when it improves decisions.

My professional work sits at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, business strategy, and project execution. I work on translating complex information into practical solutions that organizations can understand and use.

My background spans data analytics, machine-learning implementation, business systems, project management, financial operations, and digital transformation.
